<description>
Introduce a minimal variant of `linux-base-gcc`, and use it for non-GUI builds.

This saves roughly half a megabyte in binary size, in the non-GUI binaries:

| Binary | master (MB) | PR (MB) |
|---|---|---|
| bitcoin | 2.15 | 1.67 |
| bitcoin-cli | 8.20 | 7.72 |
| bitcoin-qt | 43.87 | 43.87 |
| bitcoin-tx | 4.93 | 4.45 |
| bitcoin-util | 4.52 | 4.04 |
| bitcoin-wallet | 9.26 | 8.77 |
| bitcoind | 17.75 | 17.27 |

See https://gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/libstdc++/manual/configure.html:

[quoted text omitted]
</description>

<commits>
53a1960308 depends: patch around Boost Test std::wcrtomb usage

If libstdc++ is built with --disable-wchar_t, test_bitcoin will fail to
compile.

86a8ad3eb4 guix: pass --disable-wchar_t to (non-GUI) libstdc++

[quoted text omitted]
See https://gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/libstdc++/manual/configure.html.

67b4f94edb guix: pass --with-libstdcxx-zoneinfo=no to (non-GUI) libstdc++

--with-libstdcxx-zoneinfo=OPTION
[quoted text omitted]

[quoted text omitted]
See: https://gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/libstdc++/manual/configure.html

60fe351b99 guix: pass --enable-clocale=generic to (non-GUI) libstdc++

0f07034e6c guix: pass --disable-libstdcxx-filesystem-ts to libstdc++

We don't need libstdc++fs.a, and don't use <experimental/filesystem>.
</commits>

diff --git a/depends/patches/boost/drop_wcrtomb_wchar_t.patch b/depends/patches/boost/drop_wcrtomb_wchar_t.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..f3fe8c1b3f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/depends/patches/boost/drop_wcrtomb_wchar_t.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+test: don't require std::wcrtomb for wchar_t log formatting
+
+libstdc++ built with --disable-wchar_t drops the std:: overloads
+from <cwchar>. Use the unqualified name so this keeps building against 
+such a toolchain (like in Guix).
+
+--- a/libs/test/include/boost/test/impl/test_tools.ipp
++++ b/libs/test/include/boost/test/impl/test_tools.ipp
+@@ -118,7 +118,7 @@ print_log_value<wchar_t>::operator()( std::ostream& ostr, wchar_t r )
+ {
+     std::mbstate_t state;
+     std::string mb(MB_CUR_MAX, '\0');
+-    std::size_t ret = std::wcrtomb(&mb[0], r, &state);
++    std::size_t ret = wcrtomb(&mb[0], r, &state);
+     if( ret > 0) {
+         ostr << mb;
+     }

</patch>

{
 "summary": "Configures the Guix GCC cross-compiler toolchain for non-GUI Linux targets to build libstdc++ with `--disable-wchar_t`, `--enable-clocale=generic`, and `--with-libstdcxx-zoneinfo=no`, while disabling the experimental filesystem TS library across Linux toolchains. It preserves wchar_t support for GUI builds, patches Boost Test in depends to use unqualified `wcrtomb` so tests continue to build without standard wchar_t symbols, and switches Guix module loading to `--load-path`.",
 "problem": "Release Linux binaries include unused libstdc++ features such as wide-character support, timezone information, and experimental filesystem routines, unnecessarily inflating non-GUI binary sizes.",
 "card": "This PR disables wide-character support, zoneinfo, and generic clocale in Guix cross-compiled libstdc++ for non-GUI Linux targets, keeping wchar_t enabled only for GUI targets. It also disables the libstdc++ experimental filesystem TS library and patches Boost Test in depends to build without std::wcrtomb. The change reduces the size of non-GUI release binaries like bitcoind and bitcoin-cli by roughly 0.5 MB. It is based on and includes PR #36531.",
